mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES has climbed 18.2 points over three weeks (-30.1 to -11.9), showing commuters returning to offices. Each restored commute adds weekday foot traffic to retail precincts, so the next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC exceeds its trailing mean of -9.25.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES rose from -30.1 at t-3w to -11.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: WORKPLACES continues to rise above -12 yet the next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is at or below the trailing -9.25 mean.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT sits about 35 points below baseline and is the binding constraint on trip generation. Once the TRANSIT weekly mean crosses above -35 and holds for two consecutive weeks, transit-served shopping trips resume and RETAIL_REC rises over the following two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean crosses above -35 and stays above -35 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT was -37.0 at t-2w and -34.6 at t-0w, straddling the -35 threshold
failure_condition: TRANSIT holds above -35 for two consecutive weeks but the two following weekly RETAIL_REC prints both sit below the trailing -9.25 mean.

mechanism_narrative: Retail recovery requires destination mobility plus reduced home anchoring. When WORKPLACES improves week-on-week in the same week RESIDENTIAL prints below +5.0, out-of-home discretionary trips rise and the interaction lifts RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean below +5.0 in a week when WORKPLACES improves week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL fell from 6.4 at t-2w to 3.6 at t-1w while WORKPLACES rose from -21.0 to -12.3
failure_condition: In weeks where WORKPLACES improves and RESIDENTIAL is below +5.0, RETAIL_REC fails to rise above the trailing -9.25 mean in more than half of observations.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS collapsed 19.7 points week-on-week to -30.4 at t-0w, a winter-weather outdoor-avoidance shock. The same conditions suppress discretionary trips, so RETAIL_REC prints below its trailing -9.25 mean within one week.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved from -10.7 at t-1w to -30.4 at t-0w
failure_condition: After a PARKS week-on-week drop greater than 15 points, the next weekly RETAIL_REC print is at or above the trailing -9.25 mean.

mechanism_narrative: A GROCERY_PHARM minus RETAIL_REC spread above 12 points, as at t-0w (+2.1 versus -11.6), marks precautionary household behaviour that diverts spend to essentials. The wide spread persists and drags RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM minus RETAIL_REC exceeds 12 points in a weekly print
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM 2.1 versus RETAIL_REC -11.6 at t-0w gives a spread of 13.7 points
failure_condition: After the spread exceeds 12 points, the following two RETAIL_REC prints average above the trailing -9.25 mean.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT has not exceeded -32.7 in any week while RESIDENTIAL stays above +3.5, so trip generation remains home-anchored. Without transit normalisation the retail footfall base erodes and RETAIL_REC drifts below its trailing mean over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean below -30 for three consecutive weeks while RESIDENTIAL stays above +3.5
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT was -36.6/-37.0/-32.7/-34.6 and RESIDENTIAL 6.0/6.4/3.6/5.3 across the four weeks
failure_condition: TRANSIT stays below -30 and RESIDENTIAL above +3.5 for three consecutive weeks while the next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean exceeds the trailing -9.25 mean.

mechanism_narrative: No restriction tightening is visible: WORKPLACES improves in three of four weeks and TRANSIT never falls below its t-2w low, so the -11.6 t-0w retail print is noise on a reopening path. Under an unchanged-restrictions regime RETAIL_REC reverts upward within one week.
evidence_refs: fact:no week shows simultaneous falls in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT, the signature of newly imposed restrictions
failure_condition: With WORKPLACES at or above -12 and no week-on-week decline in TRANSIT, the next weekly RETAIL_REC print stays at or below -11.6.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL rebounded from 3.6 to 5.3 while PARKS fell from -10.7 to -30.4, the signature of a winter indoor regime. Home-stay substitution persists through the seasonal transition, holding RETAIL_REC below its trailing mean for two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly rise above 1.0 point together with a PARKS weekly fall greater than 10 points
evidence_refs: fact:between t-1w and t-0w RESIDENTIAL moved 3.6 to 5.3 while PARKS moved -10.7 to -30.4
failure_condition: In weeks where RESIDENTIAL rises more than 1.0 point and PARKS falls more than 10 points, the following two RETAIL_REC prints average above -9.25.
